name: Ruby on Rails
summary: A Ruby framework for full web apps, with pages, a database layer and everything wired together by convention.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the MIT license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: New apps come with a Dockerfile, so they run on any host that runs containers.

language.note: Written in Ruby, with ERB templates for pages.

has_server_code.note: Controllers run only on the server and render pages there, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Pages are server-rendered templates with Hotwire for interactivity, not React.

setup.step: Create the app with rails new and push it to a GitHub repository.
Give your host the master key so the app can read its encrypted credentials.

builder_notes: Keep secrets in config/credentials.yml.enc (edit with bin/rails credentials:edit) and read them with Rails.application.credentials. Never commit config/master.key.
The database connection can come from the DATABASE_URL environment variable instead of config/database.yml.
